usernameReserved: That name is kept for Polaris itself
nameUnprintable: Remove the invisible or control characters
nameEmoji: Emoji cannot be part of a name
nameBroken: Some of those characters did not survive being typed
passwordIdentity: That password is too close to your name, username or address. Pick something unrelated to the account.
passwordBreached: That password has appeared in a known data breach. Pick a different one.
inviteCodeLength: That code is not the right length
inviteUnavailable: This invite is invalid, expired, or already used. Ask an administrator for a new one.
inviteLocation: This invite cannot be accepted from your network. Ask whoever sent it which addresses it allows.
invitePassword: That one-time password did not match.
inviteThrottled: Too many attempts from your network. Wait a few minutes and try again.
samlDomain: Enter a domain such as example.com.
samlMetadataUrl: Enter the full metadata address, starting with https://.
samlMetadataUrlHttps: The metadata address has to use https://.
samlNotMetadata: This is not SAML metadata: it has no EntityDescriptor.
samlEntityId: Enter the identity provider's entity ID.
samlSsoUrl: Enter the full sign-in address, starting with https://.
samlSsoUrlHttps: The sign-in address has to use https://.
